narrationScript: Welcome to the final, yet perhaps most critical, chapter of our CS50 journey: Ethical Considerations in Computer Science and The Future of Technology. Throughout this course, you've gained immense power – the ability to design, build, and deploy software that can impact millions. But with great power comes great responsibility. This chapter isn't just an add-on; it's a fundamental call to reflect on the profound consequences of our creations. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to analyze common ethical dilemmas in software development, understand the societal impact of algorithms, apply best practices for responsible development, and recognize your ongoing role in shaping an equitable technological future.
deliveryNotes: Maintain a reflective but confident tone
